name: Backfill Raised By Email
description: One-time administrative process to backfill RAISED_BY_NAME on existing SUPPORT360_TICKET rows with the raiser's resolved email (or the raw RAISED_BY id if no email can be resolved). Safe to re-run: rows already carrying a resolved value are excluded by the source filter.
source_sql: SELECT TICKET_NO AS ticket_no, RAISED_BY AS raised_by FROM SUPPORT360_TICKET WHERE RAISED_BY_NAME IS NULL OR RAISED_BY_NAME = ''

business_logic.description: Pre-persist hook: for every row given, resolve raised_by to that user's email via the platform's user/session login directory (the same lookup used by support360_create_ticket's resolve_raised_by_name business logic; never SUPPORT360_AGENT); if no email is found, use the raw raised_by id instead. Return the rows with raised_by_name set to the resolved value so the table persist writes it.
business_logic.spec: For each row in rows: look up the email for row.raised_by in the platform's user/session login directory (same source as support360_create_ticket's resolve_raised_by_name hook). Set row.raised_by_name to that email if found, otherwise to row.raised_by unchanged. Return { "rows": rows } with raised_by_name populated on every row; do not alter ticket_no or raised_by. No errors/warnings are expected in normal operation.
